status_vocabulary.IMPLEMENTED: implemented and verified in main at its own evidence tier (offline tests/verifiers pass); no runtime promotion implied
status_vocabulary.IMPLEMENTED_UNQUALIFIED: real implementation with tests in main, but not qualified to promote: missing exact venue binding, capacity, build conformance, simulation or paper evidence
status_vocabulary.IMPLEMENTED_UNBOUND: implementation exists and is tested, but is deliberately not bound into the runtime/composition path; binding is a separately gated step
status_vocabulary.FIXTURE_ONLY: runs only against fixtures; quarantined from any live path
status_vocabulary.STUB: shell, enum label or deterministic placeholder returning nothing
status_vocabulary.PLANNED: contract/boundary exists, body intentionally empty or assigned to a work package
status_vocabulary.BLOCKED: progress prevented by a typed blocker (user-gated evidence, license, credentials or missing external proof)
status_vocabulary.RESEARCH_ONLY: research model/kernels; advisory; never a runtime execution path
status_vocabulary.EXCLUDED: permanently out of the universe by owner policy or safety rule
